# Feature: Extraction-Grounded Brief Quality

## 1. Feature Goal

**ID**: FEAT-FP-003
**Source**: Plan Feature agent (self-contained — no plan file)

Make offline (`--no-llm`) Briefs genuinely readable end to end. FEAT-FP-001 fixed _what evidence gets selected_, FEAT-FP-002 fixed _how selected evidence reads_ — but both operate on extracted text that is already broken. The "fifa world cup 2026 news" run (`842c64d1`) proves the remaining failure class lives **upstream, in extraction**, plus a handful of composition gaps:

After this feature, a Brief contains:

- **no glued nav/card text** ("Match previewsMatch previewsSee allNOR1 FT2 ENG…") — block boundaries are recovered from the HTML structure, where they still exist;
- **no source footnote markers** (`[45]`, `[A]`) in any claim — which also eliminates the entire `uncited_claim_flagged` notice storm (29 notices in the reference run were all Wikipedia footnotes misread as citations);
- **no junk bullets** — table legends ("† denotes a stadium…"), timestamps + section labels ("01:18:30 | Jul 10, 2026MUST READS 🔥…"), ALL-CAPS chrome, marketing imperatives, and editorial questions are gated out;
- **no duplicate information** — a claim that restates (or contains) another merges into it with citations unioned, so one bullet shows multiple sources instead of two bullets showing one each;
- **nesting that means something** — a child bullet must be _related to but not a duplicate of_ its parent;
- **an overview that reads like a summary** — a definitional lead sentence plus the most central, mutually non-redundant claims;
- **a shorter, partly tabular "Numbers & figures" section** — figures that reduce cleanly to _value + context_ render as a table; the remainder stays as capped bullets (user-selected 2026-07-12);
- **aggregated notices** — one line with a count, never 29 near-identical lines.

Reference failure artifact: run `842c64d1-fb73-4efc-aff8-fc0d6c8fbc55` ("Fifa world cup 2026 news"), whose `fetched/` HTML captures reproduce every failure mode.

**Explicit non-goal**: offline grammar _correction_ (rewriting malformed sentences). Deterministic synthesis **selects** well-formed sentences; it does not generate text. With 859 candidate claims in the reference run, selection pressure is the honest lever.

**Verified non-bug**: the `â`/`Â`/`ð¥` mojibake in earlier artifacts is a _viewer_ decode issue, not a pipeline bug — the on-disk `brief.md` of the reference run hex-dumps as valid UTF-8 (`E2 80 99` = `'`, `F0 9F 94 A5` = 🔥, `E2 80 A0` = †). `.spec-lite/TODO.md` updated accordingly.

## 2. Technical Context

### Approach

All fixes are local, deterministic, and **wink-nlp only — no new dependencies** (user-confirmed 2026-07-12; matches FEAT-FP-002 precedent).

```text
fetched HTML
  -> ReadabilityExtractor (CHANGED)
       pre-clean: drop footnote sups, infobox/navbox chrome
       contentText: block-aware serialization of parsed.content
         (\n\n between block elements — NOT parsed.textContent)
       + consecutive-duplicate block collapse (card markup doubling)
       + textual footnote-marker strip ([45], [A], [citation needed])
       + NBSP/zero-width/pictograph normalization
  -> eligibility (CHANGED): junk-sentence gates
       glue, ALL-CAPS chrome, timestamps/pipes, symbol-led legends,
       interrogatives, marketing imperatives, well-formedness
  -> merge (CHANGED): containment-aware near-duplicate collapse
  -> topic groups (CHANGED): child = related AND NOT duplicate AND shares anchor
  -> composer (CHANGED):
       findings via MMR (diverse, non-redundant)
       overview via definitional lead + TextRank centrality
       Numbers & figures: Key-figures GFM table + capped bullets
       section caps; thin sections dropped
  -> citation-validator (CHANGED): notices aggregated + deduplicated
  -> renderers: table styling (html), table passthrough (md/terminal)
```

Root causes (all verified against run `842c64d1`'s captured HTML by re-running the real extractor):

| Symptom                                                        | Root cause                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| "Match previewsMatch previewsSee allNOR1 FT2 ENG…" finding     | `readability.ts:39` uses `parsed.textContent`, which concatenates sibling block elements with **no separator**; fifa.com card markup also renders each title twice. `BlockSegmentingAnalyzer` can't recover: the text has no newlines to split on (its own documented limitation, `block-segmentation.ts:11-13`)                                                            |
| 29 × `uncited_claim_flagged` notices                           | Wikipedia footnote markers `[45]`, `[14]`, `[5]`… survive extraction into `body_md`; the structural pass in `citation-validator.ts:83-96` correctly reports them as citations that resolve to no declared source. Fix is upstream stripping, not validator loosening — this also restores the class docblock's "deterministic Briefs always pass with zero flags" invariant |
| Child bullet duplicates its parent's tail verbatim             | Near-dup merge (`evidence-set.ts:169-181`) uses whole-text cosine ≥ 0.75; junk glued into the parent dilutes similarity below the floor. Needs a containment signal (child ⊆ parent)                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `[1][2][3] (+1)` on single-source claims                       | Glued mega-"sentences" (Wikipedia infobox = 156 glue points) act as lemma soup that clears `SUPPORT_LEMMA_OVERLAP = 0.6` for almost any claim (`eligibility.ts:416-421`). Block separation dissolves the soup                                                                                                                                                               |
| "† denotes a stadium…", "1,000th FIFA World Cup match" bullets | No gate rejects symbol-led legend lines or fragments without terminal punctuation; fragments arrive punctuation-adjacent because gluing donated a period                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| "01:18:30 \| Jul 10, 2026MUST READS 🔥The 2018…"               | Video-player chrome glued to a real sentence; no timestamp/pipe/ALL-CAPS-run gates                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Overview = same junk                                           | `composeOverview` (`deterministic.ts:312-319`) restates the top-3 findings verbatim — junk in, junk out; no centrality or diversity signal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Numbers & figures too long, all bullets                        | `composeSections` pools everything of kind `number` up to budget with no per-section cap and no tabular reduction                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Title "Fifa world cup 2026 news"                               | `composeTitle` uppercases only the first character; source titles (which carry correct casing, e.g. "FIFA") are ignored                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

Key decisions (confirmed with the user 2026-07-12):

1. **No new dependencies — wink-nlp stays the only NLP library.** Researched alternatives: `compromise` (PERSON/ORG/PLACE typing; declined — tracked in TODO), transformers.js/MiniLM embeddings (real semantic similarity but ~90 MB model download; conflicts with local-first/no-network default — tracked in TODO as opt-in idea), `retext` plugins (subsumed by a few in-house regex/POS gates). TextRank and MMR are implemented in-house (~80 lines) over the existing `analyzer.similarity` machinery.
2. **Fix extraction at the source, keep `BlockSegmentingAnalyzer`.** The decorator stays as defense for plain-text inputs that _do_ have newlines; the extractor change makes its input well-formed in the first place.
3. **"Numbers & figures" = Key-figures table + capped bullets** (user-selected over table-only and bullets-only). Figures that reduce cleanly to _(figure, context ≤ 90 chars, citations)_ become a GFM table in `body_md` when ≥ 3 rows exist; the rest stay bullets. `marked` already renders GFM tables in `to-html.ts`; `to-markdown.ts` passes `|` lines through untouched.
4. **Footnote-marker stripping happens at extraction, not synthesis.** At that stage bracketed number/letter groups are never _our_ citation markers (those are added later at composition), so a blanket strip of `[123]` / `[A]` / `[citation needed]` / `[edit]` is safe and benefits both synthesis strategies plus the research pipeline.
5. **No protocol/schema changes.** `Brief` schema, `schema_version` (`0.2`), facets, and `children` shape are untouched — tables ride inside `body_md` (free Markdown). Golden briefs and renderer snapshots regenerate (expected churn; byte-pinned by design).
6. **No backwards compatibility required** (carried from FEAT-FP-002, user-confirmed: app still in development). `ExtractedArticle.contentText` semantics change (newline-structured); internal `EvidenceClaim` gains fields; no deprecated shims.

### Spec-Specific Overrides

- **Synthesis stays pure and log-free** (unchanged FEAT-FP-001/002 exception to "structured logging everywhere") — observability via `metadata.evidence`, `metadata.citation_verdict`, and notices.
- **No new dependencies** — everything builds on `wink-nlp@2.4.0` + `wink-eng-lite-web-model@1.8.1` + `cheerio` + `marked`, all already in `@yantra/core`.
- No other overrides — see memory.

### TASK-001: Structure-aware article text extraction

The root fix. Everything downstream assumes this lands first.

- [x] **Implementation**: Create `extraction/html-to-text.ts`: pure `htmlToText(html: string): string` using `cheerio`. Recursive serializer: text nodes append verbatim; elements in `BLOCK_TAGS` (`address, article, aside, blockquote, dd, div, dl, dt, fieldset, figcaption, figure, footer, form, h1–h6, header, hr, li, main, nav, ol, p, pre, section, table, tbody, td, tfoot, th, thead, tr, ul`) emit `\n\n` around their serialized children; `<br>` emits `\n`; `td`/`th`/`tr` emit `\n` (cells must not glue). Then: split into blocks on `\n{2,}`, trim each, **drop a block whose normalized form (lowercased, whitespace-collapsed) equals the previous block's** (fifa card doubling), and re-join with `\n\n`. Normalization pass on the result: NBSP variants (`   `) → space; zero-widths (`​‌‍﻿`) stripped; `\p{Extended_Pictographic}` + variation selectors stripped; bracketed footnote markers stripped — `/\[(?:\d{1,3}|[A-Za-z])\]/g` plus `/\[(?:citation needed|edit|update|note \d+)\]/gi`; runs of 3+ newlines collapsed. '')` (fall back to `parsed.textContent` only when `parsed.content` is empty); normalize NBSP + collapse whitespace in `title`.

- **Auth**: N/A.
- **Error Handling**: Extraction keeps its existing contract — `ReadabilityExtractor.extract` returns `null` on any failure (per-source isolation in `source-processor.ts` is unchanged); `htmlToText` is total (never throws on malformed HTML — cheerio tolerates). Synthesis keeps returning `Result` with `SynthesisError` only on schema-invalid output.
- **Logging**: Synthesis remains pure and log-free (override above); extraction emits no new logs. Observability continues through `metadata.evidence`, `metadata.citation_verdict`, and notices — which this feature makes _more_ readable, not chattier.
- **Determinism**: every new function is pure; TextRank uses a fixed iteration count; MMR/tie-breaks are totally ordered. Golden suite remains byte-pinned.
